decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered through the search results to find actual backpacks as opposed to the many camping accessories (tents, sleeping bags, water bottles) included in the feed. My consideration set includes a diverse range of styles: a standard day pack (Explorer), a lightweight sling (N NEVO RHINO), a specialized cooler bag (FORICH), a feature-rich tackle bag (BASSDASH), and a high-capacity tactical pack (G4Free). I ultimately chose the G4Free Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_050) because it offers a significant 35L capacity and a high 4.6 rating at a very competitive sub-$30 price point, representing the best balance of utility and value for general outdoor or everyday use.
